chunks: Ali, from Abi Ahmad ibn Rashid, from Abi Hashim al-Ja'fari, who said:

I complained to Abi Muhammad عليه السلام of need, so he scratched the ground with his whip. He said: And I think he covered it with a cloth, and he brought out five hundred dinars. Then he said: O Aba Hashim, take, and excuse us.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام respond when Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari complained of financial need?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari complained of financial need to Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, who then produced five hundred dinars and gave them to him. The report highlights the Imam's generosity and his extraordinary act in relieving a believer's hardship.
